Christian Watson Over 4.5 receptions -118 conflicts with FantasyPros' fresh Week 3 projection of 3.9 receptions, while Watson Over 67.5 receiving yards -112 is essentially sitting on the 67.1-yard consensus projection. Tucker Kraft's bet365 receiving-yard market is now 43.5 at -116 both ways and DraftKings lists 40+ at -150, but Jayden Reed's Monday DNP remains only an estimated short-week status and there is not yet a sufficiently fresh independent Week 3 projection stack to assign a robust 4-5 point edge. Michael Penix Jr. Over 0.5 interceptions -123 is also a pass/watch because his Thursday start is confirmed but this is his first start back from ACL surgery and no robust fair interception probability has been established. Jaxson Dart's MRI result remains pending in current reliable reporting. Wait for Tuesday practice participation, injury updates, and stronger two-sided market/projection confirmation rather than force a Tuesday bet.
